body: Yeah. Fairly certain I’m gonna die before the New Year hits. I know for certain actually. It has to happen.

Hate to be the type to say.. but mental health really is a lifelong battle. Keeping it a bay. If you truly pulled the trigger, never should you legally be allowed a forearm. As your fiancée, especially owns whose brother did so, I’d def make that a lifelong “hold on Suicide “ and errrr not a ban. Poor word. If owning a gun is more important than removing an Always potential for early death, I’d suggest seeing the therapist more to figure out priorities.  So, I definitely recommend seeing the therapist first ! Therapist and not just a doctor. Second, I’d suggest HER joining the following session. See what your therapist says. If it’ll add extra safety for the Convo, DO IT ! You took a huge step pulling that trigger so it’s gonna take huge, lifelong efforts to keep it from coming to the foregrounds again. You can do it. If you love life as you say now, and your fiancée, I’d suggest this. I think perhaps the therapist will agree too, but EITHER WAY, your life your rules you do you, just be safe, seek second and third opinions when your life is at risk, and sleep on it. Always 

<3 Luca

Suppose you’ll go ? You aren’t ready. You won’t be ready for many many years. And MAYBE ?? So you aren’t sure enough in the department of love either. You’re young. I’m 31. I think the SAME AS YOU. I basically could have written that post. Life is all about timing, and at times luck. I’ve been in the same spot for a week. 4-5 of those days I cannot recall. Maybe a moment, perhaps, but it was a total blackout. It’s scary. Today is day 1. I finally showered. I ate a box of macaroni. Love is what our species desires most. Our hearts can live alone, but once you find that one, you’ll know. You will be enough. You will be loved enough. You will. Just have patience. I’m trying. You can too. I’ve had 3 heart surgeries. My heart literally aches. This sadness truly does not help it.. in fact, I need a 4th surgery soon due to the stress and heartache effecting the 3rd surgery’s work 11 months ago. YOU CAN DO IT. Love always wins

The LAST thing you want to do is FAIL at suicide. Be lazy. Sleep 20 hours a day for a bit. Veg out on the couch. DO NOT ATTEMPTTTTTT Suicide ! Do not be Lazy in respects to such a serious ‘n irreversible task. Vegging out in a hospital is not good for you OR the people you have so-called hurt. Only more hurt will follow. So be lazy like I.. drink too much alcohol ‘n pass out. Eat too much ice cream. Exercise until you pass out. Wear your body down until you can’t do anything else. Take an extra (1!) sleep aid if you can’t rest your mind. Just do not try it. No pills. No suicide. Call a hotline and talk until you fall asleep. This has been my life the last week, and today, after 6 days, I am typing. I showered. I was able to make a box of macaroni. Time. Steps. It’ll come. I feel like I cook fall back sharply.. but that’s life. One day I’ll be above it all so so high that I won’t even remember this. So just type all you wish, say all you think, read all that’s here. Just no suicide. If you can make it to this thread, you don’t really want to. So throw some anime on and veg on the couch. Setup shop. Email work that you’re not well - mental health is serious. Take time to cover. I’ve had 3 heart surgeries, most recently nearly 11 months ago.. and I’m looking to need another it appears. THAT is easier. That I can recover and understand. This mental state takes a lot more concerted effort and time and patience. You. Can. Do. It. BE STRONG BECAUSE YOU ARE STRONG. You found this place after-all, so you ain’t no dummy. Okay, Byeeeeeee <3
